svg.title: Tunisia interlock network

g.text: Cie Fermière des chemins de fer tun…

svg.text: 29 firms in 11 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 131 firms, 296 interlocks, 12 components (largest 102). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 39 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
